facts.fact: Egypt had more than 55.5 million e-wallets by June 2025 with transactions of about EGP 1.8 trillion, offered by telecom companies such as Vodafone Cash, Orange Cash and Etisalat Cash, per bank experts cited by Al-Watan.

facts.fact: The InstaPay instant payment network, launched in March 2022, carries instant transfers between accounts and e-wallets and reached about 16 million users by June 2025, per banking expert Walid Adel.
The InstaPay instant payments network, launched March 2022, handles personal, commercial and account-to-wallet transfers, with over 1.1 billion operations, per banking expert Walid Adel.
The Meeza card has become an essential tool for many government payments and official services such as traffic and the Real Estate Registry, per banking expert Hisham Hamza.
